No shorter word has a fully blocked gap; terminal counts 1,3,29,6936,6480694 and blocked counts 1,2,1,2,1 verified. Direct substring checker separately verifies all explicit insertion witnesses, and the Zimin two-block argument proves existence and general upper bound. Finite enumeration is not extrapolated to q>=7.
